items.title: Industrial AI startup Arrakis emerges from stealth with $30M Series A, $140M valuation
items.note: Blossom Capital-led round deploys AI agents into construction, manufacturing, and logistics workflows, with Datadog's and OpenAI's own execs among the angels

items.title: Cognizant becomes Anthropic's top-tier Global Premier Partner, expanding Claude across its industry platforms
items.note: More than 30,000 Cognizant employees now trained on Claude as the firm embeds it into client systems across manufacturing, life sciences and insurance

items.title: Foreclosure auctions climb to a 23-quarter high in Q2, with FHA loans leading the surge
items.note: Completed auctions hit 66% of Q1 2020 levels, up 23% year over year, as REO supply builds in the Midwest and Sun Belt

items.title: Encore AI raises $30M Series A to teach AI agents how top employees close deals
items.note: Team8-led round backs the Israeli startup's revenue-focused voice agents for banks and insurers, formerly known as Insait

items.title: Onyx Security raises $113M Series B just four months after stealth, hits $640M valuation
items.note: Bessemer-led round follows 4x revenue growth and a new Anthropic integration to secure enterprise AI agents

items.title: Aleph raises $300M for Fund V to keep backing early-stage Israeli founders
items.note: The early-stage firm stays the course, continuing to fund Israeli companies built for global markets
